climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A South West France appellation in Lot-et-Garonne for wine made from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Cot among the reds, plus whites such as Sauvignon and Sémillon.
